records.context: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. Two people labelling the same extracted image regions therefore leave two columns side by side, and this application view reports whether they agree, and on which rows they differ, before either set is used as ground truth.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.agreement#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. Two people labelling the same crops therefore leave two columns side by side, and this screen reports whether they agree, and on which rows they differ, before either set is used as ground truth.
records.translation: La aplicación Annotate escribe una columna ``INTEGER`` por pasada en ``png_list``. Por tanto, dos personas que etiquetan los mismos recortes dejan dos columnas una junto a otra, y esta pantalla informa de si coinciden y en qué filas difieren, antes de que cualquiera de los dos conjuntos se use como verdad de referencia.

records.source: Ordering matters throughout and is the reason for the length. The live preview watches ``src`` and can only be wired once both panels exist, because the settings panel owns the field and the runtime panel owns the preview. The category hints have the same constraint in reverse. The page-surface sweep runs on every route, not only where a backdrop was installed: with the ambient preference off, skipping it left every layout container carrying the blanket window fill, which is what made the settings half a solid slab.
records.translation: El orden importa en todo momento y es la razón de la longitud. La vista previa en vivo observa ``src`` y solo puede conectarse cuando existen ambos paneles, porque el panel de configuración posee el campo y el panel de ejecución posee la vista previa. Las pistas de categoría tienen la misma restricción a la inversa. El barrido de superficies de la página se ejecuta en todas las rutas, no solo donde se instaló un fondo: con la preferencia ambiental desactivada, omitirlo dejaba cada contenedor de disposición con el relleno general de la ventana, que es lo que convertía la mitad de configuración en un bloque sólido.

records.source: Only Home is rebuilt when the theme changes; every other screen is re-styled in place by re-applying the QSS. That is enough for anything whose colours come from the stylesheet, and not enough for a backdrop that paints itself — the DNA rain and the ambient background both capture their flat fill colour and their wallpaper at construction. Switching from dark to light left a black rain rectangle on a white page, and switching into Cell left it painting flat black over the micrograph the theme had just loaded. The ambient backdrop has exactly the same two captured values and therefore exactly the same two bugs.
records.translation: Solo Home se reconstruye cuando cambia el tema; todas las demás pantallas se reestilizan en su sitio volviendo a aplicar la QSS. Eso basta para todo aquello cuyos colores provienen de la hoja de estilos, y no basta para un fondo que se pinta a sí mismo: la lluvia de DNA y el fondo ambiental capturan su color de relleno plano y su fondo de pantalla al construirse. Pasar de oscuro a claro dejaba un rectángulo negro de lluvia sobre una página blanca, y pasar a Cell lo dejaba pintando negro plano sobre la micrografía que el tema acababa de cargar. El fondo ambiental tiene exactamente los mismos dos valores capturados y, por tanto, exactamente los mismos dos errores.

records.context: Both palette events count, and that is the whole reason this works. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — which is what :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` ends in — delivers ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **only to top-level widgets** (Qt 6.11, verified); every child, including every AppScreen inside MainWindow's stack, gets ``PaletteChange`` instead. Listening for the application event alone meant this handler fired in the tests that synthesised it and never once in the running app.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Both palette events count, and that is the whole reason this works. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — which is what :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` ends in — delivers ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **only to top-level widgets** (Qt 6.11, verified); every child, including every AppScreen inside MainWindow's stack, gets ``PaletteChange`` instead. Listening for the application event alone meant this handler fired in the tests that synthesised it and never once in the running app.
records.translation: Ambos eventos de paleta cuentan, y esa es toda la razón de que esto funcione. ``QApplication.setPalette``, que es en lo que termina :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette`, entrega ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **solo a los widgets de nivel superior** (Qt 6.11, verificado); cada hijo, incluidas todas las AppScreen dentro de la pila de MainWindow, recibe ``PaletteChange`` en su lugar. Escuchar solo el evento de la aplicación hacía que este manejador se activara en las pruebas que lo sintetizaban y ni una sola vez en la aplicación en ejecución.

records.source: LISTS AND TUPLES ARE NOT A CORNER CASE. Classify's ``src`` is list-valued and regression's ``count_data``, ``score_data`` and ``paired_data`` are too, and ``utils.load_settings`` turns any CSV cell starting with ``[``, ``(`` or ``{`` into a real Python container. An earlier version of this method tested ``isinstance(value, str)`` and skipped everything else, which skipped exactly the two modules whose loaders never write a local path as a fallback -- so for those the publisher's path was the panel's only source of truth. Containers are walked.
records.translation: LAS LISTAS Y LAS TUPLAS NO SON UN CASO LÍMITE. El ``src`` de Classify tiene valores de lista, y también ``count_data``, ``score_data`` y ``paired_data`` de la regresión, y ``utils.load_settings`` convierte cualquier celda CSV que empiece por ``[``, ``(`` o ``{`` en un contenedor real de Python. Una versión anterior de este método comprobaba ``isinstance(value, str)`` y omitía todo lo demás, lo que omitía exactamente los dos módulos cuyos cargadores nunca escriben una ruta local como alternativa, de modo que para ellos la ruta del publicador era la única fuente de verdad del panel. Los contenedores se recorren.

records.context: Most of the per-path work is not new. :func:`spacr.portable_paths.reroot_crop_path` already picks the deepest recorded suffix that EXISTS below the current root, so a rewrite is only made when the reconstructed path is really there; it is tried first and its answer preferred. What it cannot do is the root itself -- its resolution needs a suffix to match, and ``src`` pointing at the plate folder has none, which is the reported case. That one gap is filled by matching the destination's own folder name.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Most of the per-path work is not new. :func:`spacr.portable_paths.reroot_crop_path` already picks the deepest recorded suffix that EXISTS below the current root, so a rewrite is only made when the reconstructed path is really there; it is tried first and its answer preferred. What it cannot do is the root itself -- its resolution needs a suffix to match, and ``src`` pointing at the plate folder has none, which is the reported case. That one gap is filled by matching the destination's own folder name.
records.translation: La mayor parte del trabajo por ruta no es nueva. :func:`spacr.portable_paths.reroot_crop_path` ya elige el sufijo registrado más profundo que EXISTE bajo la raíz actual, de modo que solo se reescribe cuando la ruta reconstruida realmente está ahí; se prueba primero y se prefiere su respuesta. Lo que no puede hacer es la propia raíz: su resolución necesita un sufijo que coincida, y un ``src`` que apunta a la carpeta de la placa no tiene ninguno, que es el caso notificado. Ese único hueco se cubre haciendo coincidir el nombre de la propia carpeta de destino.

records.context: Every module application view **except** the ones that already animate something of their own — which today is exactly :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. Sequencing's rain is *about* sequencing: bases falling behind the application view that maps reads to barcodes. Putting a second, unrelated animation behind it would fight it — two independent motions competing for the same pixels, neither readable, and two animation timers executing on the one application view that already had one. So an application view gets one animated background or none, never both.

records.source: Every module screen **except** the ones that already animate something of their own — which today is exactly :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. Sequencing's rain is *about* sequencing: bases falling behind the screen that maps reads to barcodes. Putting a second, unrelated animation behind it would fight it — two independent motions competing for the same pixels, neither readable, and two animation timers running on the one screen that already had one. So a screen gets one animated background or none, never both.
records.translation: Todas las pantallas de módulo **excepto** las que ya animan algo propio, que hoy son exactamente :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. La lluvia de Sequencing *trata* de secuenciación: bases que caen detrás de la pantalla que asigna lecturas a códigos de barras. Poner detrás una segunda animación sin relación entraría en conflicto con ella: dos movimientos independientes compitiendo por los mismos píxeles, ninguno legible, y dos temporizadores de animación en la única pantalla que ya tenía uno. Así que una pantalla recibe un fondo animado o ninguno, nunca ambos.

records.context: Written as a rule with a name rather than as an ``else`` on the rain's ``if``: the two backdrops are chosen by *one* decision, and the day a second module earns a themed animation of its own, adding its key to :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`-style membership is all that is needed for the ambient one to step aside.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.uses_ambient_background#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Written as a rule with a name rather than as an ``else`` on the rain's ``if``: the two backdrops are chosen by *one* decision, and the day a second module earns a themed animation of its own, adding its key to :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`-style membership is all that is needed for the ambient one to step aside.
records.translation: Se escribe como una regla con nombre y no como un ``else`` del ``if`` de la lluvia: los dos fondos se eligen con *una* sola decisión, y el día que un segundo módulo se gane una animación temática propia, añadir su clave a una pertenencia al estilo de :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS` es todo lo que se necesita para que el ambiental se haga a un lado.

records.context: **Jobs are validated when they are added, not when they run.** A job whose settings file is missing, whose ``src`` is misspelled or whose module is GUI-only is refused at the Add button, with the reason inline, instead of failing when the software job list reaches it.

records.source: **Jobs are validated when they are added, not when they run.** A job whose settings file is missing, whose ``src`` is misspelled or whose module is GUI-only is refused at the Add button, with the reason inline, instead of failing when the queue reaches it.
records.translation: **Los trabajos se validan cuando se añaden, no cuando se ejecutan.** Un trabajo cuyo archivo de configuración falta, cuyo ``src`` está mal escrito o cuyo módulo es solo de GUI se rechaza en el botón Add, con el motivo integrado, en lugar de fallar cuando la cola llega a él.

records.context: The run uses a worker. **Execution model:** completion returns to the GUI thread. ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *inside the worker thread*; therefore each receiver that changes a widget uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.batch#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The run happens off the GUI thread, and its completion handler comes back onto it.** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *in the worker thread*; every widget-mutating receiver therefore uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.
records.translation: **La ejecución ocurre fuera del hilo de la GUI, y su manejador de finalización vuelve a él.** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` se emite *en el hilo de trabajo*; por tanto, cada receptor que modifica widgets usa una conexión en cola explícita a un método enlazado de este widget del hilo de la GUI.

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.classifier_evaluation#3

records.source: Every cell of the matrix is clickable, and clicking one asks :func:`spacr.qt.linked_selection.open_objects` for exactly the crops that cell counted, so "43 uninfected called infected" opens those 43 crops. The analysis behind it is in :mod:`spacr.confusion`, which has no Qt in it; this file is the table, the two lists and the buttons.
records.translation: Cada celda de la matriz admite clics, y hacer clic en una pide a :func:`spacr.qt.linked_selection.open_objects` exactamente los recortes que contó esa celda, así que "43 uninfected called infected" abre esos 43 recortes. El análisis subyacente está en :mod:`spacr.confusion`, que no contiene Qt; este archivo es la tabla, las dos listas y los botones.

records.context: Two lists, not one, per cell. The model being **sure** and wrong is evidence against the *annotation*; the model being **unsure** and wrong is evidence about the *boundary*. They are different diagnoses with different fixes, so they are opened separately and never blended into one confidence-sorted list where the distinction disappears somewhere in the middle of a scroll.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.classifier_evaluation#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two lists, not one, per cell. The model being **sure** and wrong is evidence against the *annotation*; the model being **unsure** and wrong is evidence about the *boundary*. They are different diagnoses with different fixes, so they are opened separately and never blended into one confidence-sorted list where the distinction disappears somewhere in the middle of a scroll.
records.translation: Dos listas por celda, no una. Que el modelo esté **seguro** y se equivoque es evidencia contra la *anotación*; que esté **inseguro** y se equivoque es evidencia sobre la *frontera*. Son diagnósticos distintos con soluciones distintas, así que se abren por separado y nunca se mezclan en una sola lista ordenada por confianza en la que la distinción desaparece en algún punto a mitad del desplazamiento.

records.context: Each cell is also broken down per microplate sample position and per laboratory microplate, which shows where the errors came from: 43 errors spread over 20 microplate sample positions point to the model, 43 errors from one microplate sample position point to that microplate sample position.

records.source: Each cell is also broken down per well and per plate, which shows where the errors came from: 43 errors spread over 20 wells point to the model, 43 errors from one well point to that well.
records.translation: Cada celda también se desglosa por pocillo y por placa, lo que muestra de dónde vienen los errores: 43 errores repartidos en 20 pocillos apuntan al modelo; 43 errores de un solo pocillo apuntan a ese pocillo.

records.context: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks, and the analysis assumes that the controls behave the same way every time. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all measure against them, so when the controls drift, every downstream result shifts with them without any warning — the analysis normalises to whatever controls it is handed.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks, and the analysis assumes that the controls behave the same way every time. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all measure against them, so when the controls drift, every downstream result shifts with them without any warning — the analysis normalises to whatever controls it is handed.
records.translation: Una campaña de cribado son decenas de placas procesadas a lo largo de semanas, y el análisis supone que los controles se comportan igual cada vez. La selección de aciertos, la normalización por placa y Z' se miden respecto a ellos, de modo que, cuando los controles derivan, todos los resultados posteriores se desplazan con ellos sin ningún aviso: el análisis normaliza respecto a los controles que se le entreguen.

records.context: Everything numeric comes from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, which has no Qt in it and documents the reasoning for every decision — most of all the central one, that sigma comes from the average moving range over d2 and never from the standard deviation of the series, because the SD is inflated by exactly the drift the chart exists to detect. This file draws that result and nothing else: no statistic is computed here, so the chart on application view and the chart in a report cannot disagree.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.control_chart#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything numeric comes from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, which has no Qt in it and documents the reasoning for every decision — most of all the central one, that sigma comes from the average moving range over d2 and never from the standard deviation of the series, because the SD is inflated by exactly the drift the chart exists to detect. This file draws that result and nothing else: no statistic is computed here, so the chart on screen and the chart in a report cannot disagree.
records.translation: Todo lo numérico procede de :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, que no contiene Qt y documenta el razonamiento de cada decisión, sobre todo la central: que sigma se obtiene del rango móvil medio dividido entre d2 y nunca de la desviación estándar de la serie, porque la SD está inflada precisamente por la deriva que el gráfico existe para detectar. Este archivo dibuja ese resultado y nada más: aquí no se calcula ninguna estadística, así que el gráfico en pantalla y el gráfico de un informe no pueden discrepar.

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.convert#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate's worth of ND2 headers takes seconds; converting takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **Fuera del hilo de la GUI.** Escanear las cabeceras ND2 de una placa entera lleva segundos; convertir lleva minutos. Ambas operaciones pasan por :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, y al manejador de finalización se llega mediante un *método enlazado* (:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`) y no un cierre, porque ``PipelineWorker.finished`` se emite en el hilo de trabajo y un cierre conectado a él construiría allí widgets hijos. Las pruebas pasan ``threaded=False``.

The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of extracted image regions must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the main GUI execution path, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on application view — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.

records.source: The dialog fills in two stages. The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of crops must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the GUI thread, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on screen — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.
records.translation: El diálogo se rellena en dos etapas. La lista de archivos no se almacena en el plan: cada llamada a ``file_list`` ejecuta ``os.walk`` sobre cada directorio candidato, porque un plan para un proyecto con millones de recortes no debe llevar millones de cadenas. Hacerlo en ``__init__`` pondría un recorrido recursivo completo del proyecto del usuario en el hilo de la GUI, justo en el momento en que espera que aparezca una ventana, y en un recurso compartido en reposo el primer stat del recorrido puede tardar por sí solo veinte segundos mientras se activa el montaje. Por eso el diálogo se abre con la mitad que no necesita nada del disco (los totales, cada candidato, cada elemento conservado y su motivo) y la lista de archivos llega detrás. No se omite nada: el usuario sigue leyendo cada ruta antes de que se elimine nada, y por eso la confirmación se mantiene deshabilitada hasta que la lista está en pantalla o, cuando el recorrido falla, hasta que :meth:`_on_listing_failed` lo ha indicado en lugar de la lista. La casilla nunca se habilita mientras la lista muestra un marcador de posición.

records.translation: Toda la estadística está en :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response` y aquí no hay nada. records.context: **Refusals and one-sided bounds are rows, not silence.** A laboratory microplate where three compounds fit and the fourth is cytotoxic at the top dose has four rows. The cytotoxic one says ``refused`` and carries the engine's message; a compound whose midpoint sits past the highest dose says ``unbounded`` and carries ``EC50 > 30 µM``, with an empty EC50 cell. Neither is dropped from the table, so a refused or unbounded fit is not shown as missing data.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.dose_response#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Refusals and one-sided bounds are rows, not silence.** A plate where three compounds fit and the fourth is cytotoxic at the top dose has four rows. The cytotoxic one says ``refused`` and carries the engine's message; a compound whose midpoint sits past the highest dose says ``unbounded`` and carries ``EC50 > 30 µM``, with an empty EC50 cell. Neither is dropped from the table, so a refused or unbounded fit is not shown as missing data.
records.translation: **Los rechazos y las cotas unilaterales son filas, no silencio.** Una placa en la que tres compuestos se ajustan y el cuarto es citotóxico a la dosis máxima tiene cuatro filas. El citotóxico indica ``refused`` y lleva el mensaje del motor; un compuesto cuyo punto medio queda más allá de la dosis más alta indica ``unbounded`` y lleva ``EC50 > 30 µM``, con la celda de EC50 vacía. Ninguno se elimina de la tabla, de modo que un ajuste rechazado o no acotado no aparece como dato faltante.

records.translation: **El selector Curve ofrece el modelo asimétrico y no lo elige.** El ajuste usa el modelo de cuatro parámetros salvo que se elija el de cinco, y un ajuste de cinco parámetros informa de una prueba F del parámetro añadido (``asymmetry_p``). Elegir por grupo el modelo que mejor se ajusta daría a una placa EC50s procedentes de dos modelos distintos.

records.context: **Off the main GUI execution path.** Scanning a plate of TIFFs and reading every label image takes seconds; the import takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the background execution unit and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.

records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate of TIFFs and reading every label image takes seconds; the import takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **Fuera del hilo de la GUI.** Escanear una placa de TIFFs y leer cada imagen de etiquetas lleva segundos; la importación lleva minutos. Ambas operaciones pasan por :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, y al manejador de finalización se llega mediante un *método enlazado* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) y no un cierre, porque ``PipelineWorker.finished`` se emite en el hilo de trabajo y un cierre conectado a él construiría allí widgets hijos. Las pruebas pasan ``threaded=False``.

records.context: Nothing here touches the file on the main GUI execution path. The read executes on a background execution unit -- ``SELECT * FROM cell`` into pandas measures 1.5 s for a 200 000-row measurement table on a warm local SSD -- and listing the tables runs there too, even though one ``sqlite_master`` query costs 0.4 ms, because that cost holds only for a disk that answers. Measured on one workstation, a single ``stat`` under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- had not returned after twenty seconds, and ``sqlite3.connect`` opens the file before it can read a byte of ``sqlite_master``. records.context: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host application view's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host application views embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask application view embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask application view's says "Live".
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host screen's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host screens embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask screen embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask screen's says "Live".
records.translation: Estructuralmente es el hermano de :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: un :class:`QWidget` autónomo que posee sus propios controles, ejecuta el trabajo costoso en un :class:`QThread`, devuelve los resultados mediante señales, informa de cada fallo de forma integrada (nunca en un diálogo modal: un QMessageBox bloquea una ejecución sin interfaz gráfica) y devuelve una configuración elegida al panel de configuración de la pantalla anfitriona mediante un callback que registra el anfitrión. Las pantallas anfitrionas lo integran con :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactamente igual que la pantalla Mask integra la vista previa en vivo, y lo activan con una etiqueta que dice "Hyperparameter search" donde la de la pantalla Mask dice "Live".

records.context: The panel does not report only a winner. The table is ordered by the criterion the user picked, and the panel also draws the small-multiples panel (embeddings for UMAP, score-versus-trial with the noise band for the machine-learning classification models) and prints the spread, the within-noise flag and the failure count, which show whether the best configuration differs meaningfully from the others. See :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` for why.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The panel does not report only a winner. See :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` for why.
records.translation: El panel no informa solo de un ganador. La tabla se ordena según el criterio que eligió el usuario, y el panel también dibuja el panel de múltiplos pequeños (embeddings para UMAP, puntuación frente a ensayo con la banda de ruido para los clasificadores) e imprime la dispersión, el indicador de dentro del ruido y el número de fallos, que muestran si la mejor configuración difiere de forma significativa de las demás. Consulte :mod:`spacr.hyperparam` para saber por qué.

records.source: **Scan writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` walks a sample of the tree and reads each file's own axis metadata; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a problem — because every problem the plan states is a way for the result to be quietly wrong, and the import is the irreversible half.
records.translation: **Scan no escribe nada.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` recorre una muestra del árbol y lee los metadatos de ejes propios de cada archivo; ``Import`` es una pulsación aparte, y permanece deshabilitado mientras el plan tenga un problema, porque cada problema que indica el plan es una forma de que el resultado sea erróneo en silencio, y la importación es la mitad irreversible.

records.context: **The proposal table is not editable, and the answer table is.** A wrong guess is never wrong for one file: it is wrong for a token position, in every name that has one. So the correction is made where the mistake lives, one answer fixing every file that shares it, rather than by retyping eight thousand rows. That is also the only correction :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` can apply without re-walking the disk, which is what makes editing instant.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_import#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The proposal table is not editable, and the answer table is.** A wrong guess is never wrong for one file: it is wrong for a token position, in every name that has one. So the correction is made where the mistake lives, one answer fixing every file that shares it, rather than by retyping eight thousand rows. That is also the only correction :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` can apply without re-walking the disk, which is what makes editing instant.
records.translation: **La tabla de propuesta no es editable, y la tabla de respuestas sí.** Una suposición errónea nunca lo es para un solo archivo: lo es para una posición de token, en cada nombre que la tenga. Así que la corrección se hace donde está el error, con una respuesta que corrige todos los archivos que la comparten, en lugar de volver a escribir ocho mil filas. Esa es también la única corrección que :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` puede aplicar sin volver a recorrer el disco, que es lo que hace instantánea la edición.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Everything the plan could not place is on screen**, with its values, and counted. Silence about unparsed files is how a plate imports with a third of its fields missing.
records.translation: **Todo lo que el plan no pudo ubicar está en pantalla**, con sus valores, y contado. Callar sobre los archivos no analizados es como una placa se importa con un tercio de sus campos ausentes.

records.context: **Off the main GUI execution path.** A scan reads every file's header; an import of a 400-plate archive takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ImageImportScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the background execution unit and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_import#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** A scan reads every file's header; an import of a 400-plate archive takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ImageImportScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **Fuera del hilo de la GUI.** Un escaneo lee la cabecera de cada archivo; importar un archivo histórico de 400 placas lleva minutos. Ambas operaciones pasan por :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, y al manejador de finalización se llega mediante un *método enlazado* (:attr:`ImageImportScreen._job_settled`) y no un cierre, porque ``PipelineWorker.finished`` se emite en el hilo de trabajo y un cierre conectado a él construiría allí widgets hijos. Las pruebas pasan ``threaded=False``.

records.context: A hover handler runs sixty-plus times a second and a PNG decode costs milliseconds, so the obvious implementation — decode the extracted image region under the cursor in ``mouseMoveEvent`` — produces a plot that lags behind the mouse. Three measures keep hover responsive:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A hover handler runs sixty-plus times a second and a PNG decode costs milliseconds, so the obvious implementation — decode the crop under the cursor in ``mouseMoveEvent`` — produces a plot that lags behind the mouse. Three measures keep hover responsive:
records.translation: Un manejador de paso del cursor se ejecuta más de sesenta veces por segundo y decodificar un PNG cuesta milisegundos, así que la implementación obvia (decodificar el recorte bajo el cursor en ``mouseMoveEvent``) produce un gráfico que va por detrás del ratón. Tres medidas mantienen la respuesta ágil:

records.context: The point cloud is painted once into a pixmap and blitted. Hover repaints a ring, never ninety thousand dots.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The point cloud is painted once into a pixmap and blitted. Hover repaints a ring, never ninety thousand dots.
records.translation: La nube de puntos se pinta una vez en un pixmap y se copia en bloque. Al pasar el cursor se repinta un anillo, nunca noventa mil puntos.

records.context: Extracted image region paths are resolved for the whole plot in one database pass at load time (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), so hover is a key-value mapping lookup rather than a query.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Crop paths are resolved for the whole plot in one database pass at load time (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), so hover is a dict lookup rather than a query.
records.translation: Las rutas de los recortes se resuelven para todo el gráfico en una sola pasada por la base de datos al cargar (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), de modo que pasar el cursor es una búsqueda en un diccionario y no una consulta.

records.context: Decoding is behind a short debounce and an LRU (:class:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails`). Sweeping the cursor across a cluster decodes what the cursor *stopped* on, not everything it crossed; an extracted image region already in the cache appears with no delay at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Decoding is behind a short debounce and an LRU (:class:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails`). Sweeping the cursor across a cluster decodes what the cursor *stopped* on, not everything it crossed; a crop already in the cache appears with no delay at all.
records.translation: La decodificación está tras un breve antirrebote y una LRU (:class:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails`). Barrer el cursor sobre un grupo decodifica aquello en lo que el cursor se *detuvo*, no todo lo que cruzó; un recorte que ya está en la caché aparece sin ningún retardo.

records.context: What is on application view, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes.BarcodeSearchPanel#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What is on screen, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.translation: Qué hay en pantalla y por qué está cada parte. La tabla de hallazgos lleva la tasa observada y la tasa esperada por coincidencia en columnas adyacentes, con la razón entre ellas junto a ambas, porque una tasa sola no se puede distinguir de un accidente y este panel existe para evitar que alguien actúe basándose en uno. La ventana de texto muestra lecturas con sus coincidencias coloreadas por tipo de código de barras, porque un código de barras que cae en las mismas columnas fila tras fila es la prueba que zanja una discusión que un porcentaje no puede zanjar. La propuesta muestra el valor que contiene el formulario junto al valor que sugiere la búsqueda, de modo que lo que Apply va a hacer es legible antes de que lo haga.

records.context: What it costs. Every file is read inside a submitted job, one chunk at a time, so the interface stays live throughout and a search can be abandoned at any point. Cancelling proposes nothing: an interrupted measurement is an honest partial report and a dishonest recommendation.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What it costs. Every file is read inside a submitted job, one chunk at a time, so the interface stays live throughout and a search can be abandoned at any point. Cancelling proposes nothing: an interrupted measurement is an honest partial report and a dishonest recommendation.
records.translation: Lo que cuesta. Cada archivo se lee dentro de un trabajo enviado, un bloque cada vez, de modo que la interfaz sigue respondiendo en todo momento y una búsqueda puede abandonarse en cualquier punto. Cancelar no propone nada: una medición interrumpida es un informe parcial honesto y una recomendación deshonesta.

records.context: The sequencing folder of a real screen holds several samples, and one of them is enough. Which mate carries which barcode, which orientation the reference tables are stored in relative to the reads, and where in the read the barcodes sit are all properties of the library and the sequencing run rather than of a sample, so measuring them on the first sample settles them for every sample beside it. The others are counted rather than read, and the count is reported so that nobody has to wonder whether they were forgotten.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes.plan_barcode_search#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The sequencing folder of a real screen holds several samples, and one of them is enough. Which mate carries which barcode, which orientation the reference tables are stored in relative to the reads, and where in the read the barcodes sit are all properties of the library and the sequencing run rather than of a sample, so measuring them on the first sample settles them for every sample beside it. The others are counted rather than read, and the count is reported so that nobody has to wonder whether they were forgotten.
records.translation: La carpeta de secuenciación de un cribado real contiene varias muestras, y basta con una. Qué par lleva qué código de barras, en qué orientación están almacenadas las tablas de referencia respecto a las lecturas y en qué parte de la lectura se sitúan los códigos de barras son propiedades de la biblioteca y de la ejecución de secuenciación, no de una muestra, así que medirlas en la primera muestra las determina para todas las muestras que la acompañan. Las demás se cuentan en lugar de leerse, y el recuento se informa para que nadie tenga que preguntarse si se olvidaron.

records.context: **The resolved-parameter table.** Cellpose 4 accepts ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` and then ignores every one of them, and it resolves all the pre-SAM model names to ``cpsam``. records.source: **The resolved-parameter table.** Cellpose 4 accepts ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` and then ignores every one of them, and it resolves all the pre-SAM model names to ``cpsam``. A comparison that differs only in one of those reports "no difference", which reads as "the models are equivalent" rather than "you changed nothing". So the screen shows what actually reached each model, marks what was dropped, and says so in a banner above the numbers.
records.translation: **La tabla de parámetros resueltos.** Cellpose 4 acepta ``model_type``, ``diam_mean``, ``nchan``, ``channels`` y ``rescale`` y luego ignora todos ellos, y resuelve todos los nombres de modelos anteriores a SAM como ``cpsam``. Una comparación que solo difiere en uno de ellos informa de "no difference" (ninguna diferencia), lo que se lee como "the models are equivalent" (los modelos son equivalentes) en lugar de "you changed nothing" (no se cambió nada). Por eso la pantalla muestra lo que realmente llegó a cada modelo, marca lo que se descartó y lo indica en un aviso encima de los números.

records.source: Multi-channel fields are collapsed to their max projection rather than a mean: a nucleus channel averaged with an empty channel is a dim nucleus. Contrast is a 1-99.9 percentile stretch, the same window :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.normalize_uint16` uses. A missing or wrong-shaped image comes back black rather than raising, because the backdrop is only context for the masks.
records.translation: Los campos multicanal se reducen a su proyección máxima y no a una media: un canal de núcleos promediado con un canal vacío es un núcleo tenue. El contraste es un estiramiento entre los percentiles 1-99.9, la misma ventana que usa :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.normalize_uint16`. Una imagen ausente o con forma incorrecta vuelve en negro en lugar de generar una excepción, porque el fondo es solo contexto para las máscaras.

records.context: **Provenance is a column, not a tooltip.** "What was this trained on" is what decides whether a model applies to your images at all, so it is in the table and spelled ``unknown`` where it is unknown — a blank cell reads as "no constraints", which is the opposite of what it means.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Provenance is a column, not a tooltip.** "What was this trained on" is what decides whether a model applies to your images at all, so it is in the table and spelled ``unknown`` where it is unknown — a blank cell reads as "no constraints", which is the opposite of what it means.
records.translation: **La procedencia es una columna, no una información emergente.** "What was this trained on" (con qué se entrenó) es lo que decide si un modelo se aplica siquiera a sus imágenes, así que está en la tabla y se escribe ``unknown`` donde se desconoce: una celda vacía se lee como "no constraints" (sin restricciones), que es lo contrario de lo que significa.

records.context: **Downloads are off the main GUI execution path, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Downloads are off the GUI thread, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.translation: **Las descargas se hacen fuera del hilo de la GUI, son atómicas y se pueden cancelar.** Los bytes van a un archivo temporal dentro del destino y solo se renombran cuando se supera la suma de comprobación (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), de modo que Cancel deja el destino exactamente como estaba: ningún archivo a medio escribir con un nombre que parezca un modelo.

records.context: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no models, a checksum mismatch, a corrupt checkpoint, a cancelled download: all inline. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no models, a checksum mismatch, a corrupt checkpoint, a cancelled download: all inline. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.
records.translation: **Ningún diálogo modal en ninguna ruta de error.** Una carpeta sin modelos, una suma de comprobación que no coincide, un punto de control dañado, una descarga cancelada: todo integrado. Un QMessageBox bloquea una ejecución sin interfaz gráfica.

records.context: The **Objects** tab is the per-object flags; the **Microplate sample positions** tab is the across-well pass. They are separate tabs rather than one merged view because they answer different questions and routinely disagree: a well shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless the most extreme point among microplate sample positions. The engine's ``report()`` is shown verbatim in the third tab, caveats included — the share flagged is not interpretable without the sentence saying whether a symmetric fence on skewed data produced it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.outliers#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The **Objects** tab is the per-object flags; the **Wells** tab is the across-well pass. They are separate tabs rather than one merged view because they answer different questions and routinely disagree: a well shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless the most extreme point among wells. The engine's ``report()`` is shown verbatim in the third tab, caveats included — the share flagged is not interpretable without the sentence saying whether a symmetric fence on skewed data produced it.
records.translation: La pestaña **Objects** contiene los indicadores por objeto; la pestaña **Wells** es la pasada entre pocillos. Son pestañas separadas y no una vista fusionada porque responden a preguntas distintas y discrepan con frecuencia: un pocillo desplazado en su conjunto marca casi ninguno de sus objetos individuales y, sin embargo, es el punto más extremo entre los pocillos. El ``report()`` del motor se muestra literalmente en la tercera pestaña, con sus advertencias: la proporción marcada no es interpretable sin la frase que indica si la produjo una valla simétrica sobre datos asimétricos.

records.context: A filter change **recomputes** the decomposition rather than just re-drawing it. PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pca#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A filter change **recomputes** the decomposition rather than just re-drawing it. PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.translation: Un cambio de filtro **recalcula** la descomposición en lugar de limitarse a redibujarla. El PCA es una propiedad de una población: el centro, la escala y las direcciones de los componentes se calculan todos a partir de sus filas. Conservar los componentes antiguos y quitar los puntos filtrados dibujaría un gráfico cuyos ejes pertenecen a una población que el usuario ya no está mirando: las puntuaciones seguirían en la base antigua, y un grupo que se separa en el subconjunto filtrado no aparecería. Por eso el filtro está antes del cálculo, el recálculo tiene antirrebote y el informe bajo el gráfico vuelve a indicar el número de filas cada vez.

The refusals -- no frame yet, and a failed aggregation -- are unchanged and still synchronous, because the first does no work and the second is reported by the completion handler in exactly the place it was reported before. So the only caller-visible difference is that ``True`` may arrive before the grid is painted.
records.translation: ``recompute()`` devuelve un bool que lee quien llama, y significa "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" (se dibujó una placa o se está dibujando) y no "a plate was drawn" (se dibujó una placa). Los rechazos (todavía no hay marco, y una agregación fallida) no cambian y siguen siendo síncronos, porque el primero no hace ningún trabajo y el segundo lo notifica el manejador de finalización exactamente donde se notificaba antes. Así que la única diferencia visible para quien llama es que ``True`` puede llegar antes de que se pinte la cuadrícula.

records.context: A coefficient table says which terms matter. It does not show what the model predicts for a given well, or how the prediction changes when one gRNA's fraction doubles while the other inputs stay fixed. This screen shows that: one input is swept and the others are held at chosen values.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A coefficient table says which terms matter. It does not show what the model predicts for a given well, or how the prediction changes when one gRNA's fraction doubles while the other inputs stay fixed. This screen shows that: one input is swept and the others are held at chosen values.
records.translation: Una tabla de coeficientes indica qué términos importan. No muestra qué predice el modelo para un pocillo dado, ni cómo cambia la predicción cuando la fracción de un gRNA se duplica mientras las demás entradas permanecen fijas. Esta pantalla lo muestra: se recorre una entrada y las demás se mantienen en valores elegidos.

records.context: The left column is :func:`spacr.profiler.sensitivity` — every input ranked by how far it actually moves the prediction, not by its coefficient, because a large coefficient on an input that never varies moves nothing. In a design with thousands of terms, the ranking shows which input to profile first.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The left column is :func:`spacr.profiler.sensitivity` — every input ranked by how far it actually moves the prediction, not by its coefficient, because a large coefficient on an input that never varies moves nothing. In a design with thousands of terms, the ranking shows which input to profile first.
records.translation: La columna izquierda es :func:`spacr.profiler.sensitivity`: cada entrada clasificada por cuánto mueve realmente la predicción, no por su coeficiente, porque un coeficiente grande en una entrada que nunca varía no mueve nada. En un diseño con miles de términos, la clasificación muestra qué entrada perfilar primero.

records.context: **Nothing is re-fitted.** The screen reads a coefficient table a regression processing session already wrote and wraps it in :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, which is *reading* the fit. Re-fitting would show a second model under the first one's name, and on a penalised backend with ``alpha='auto'`` its coefficients can differ. A caller that has a live fitted object can hand it straight to :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` and skip the file entirely.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Nothing is re-fitted.** The screen reads a coefficient table a regression run already wrote and wraps it in :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, which is *reading* the fit. Re-fitting would show a second model under the first one's name, and on a penalised backend with ``alpha='auto'`` its coefficients can differ. A caller that has a live fitted object can hand it straight to :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` and skip the file entirely.
records.translation: **No se vuelve a ajustar nada.** La pantalla lee una tabla de coeficientes que ya escribió una ejecución de regresión y la envuelve en :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, que *lee* el ajuste. Volver a ajustar mostraría un segundo modelo con el nombre del primero, y en un backend penalizado con ``alpha='auto'`` sus coeficientes pueden diferir. Quien tenga un objeto ajustado en vivo puede entregarlo directamente a :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` y prescindir del archivo por completo.

records.context: **The link is named, not guessed.** A coefficient table does not record which inverse link produced it, and applying the wrong one draws a plausible curve on the wrong scale. So the link is a control the user sets, it defaults to identity, and the axis label always says which one is in force.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The link is named, not guessed.** A coefficient table does not record which inverse link produced it, and applying the wrong one draws a plausible curve on the wrong scale. So the link is a control the user sets, it defaults to identity, and the axis label always says which one is in force.
records.translation: **La función de enlace se indica, no se adivina.** Una tabla de coeficientes no registra qué enlace inverso la produjo, y aplicar el equivocado dibuja una curva verosímil en la escala equivocada. Por eso el enlace es un control que establece el usuario, su valor predeterminado es la identidad, y la etiqueta del eje siempre indica cuál está en vigor.

records.source: **A project the registry has never seen is still listed.** Projects are found by walking the disk, so a folder copied from a colleague appears the moment the browser is pointed at its parent — with its stage, its size and the date its files were last written. What it does *not* show is "0 stale", which would read as *clean*: with no provenance there is nothing to compare against, so the state column says "unknown — nothing recorded" and the note says why.
records.translation: **Un proyecto que el registro nunca ha visto sigue apareciendo.** Los proyectos se encuentran recorriendo el disco, así que una carpeta copiada de un colega aparece en cuanto se apunta el explorador a su carpeta superior, con su etapa, su tamaño y la fecha en que se escribieron por última vez sus archivos. Lo que *no* muestra es "0 stale" (0 obsoletos), que se leería como *limpio*: sin procedencia no hay nada con lo que comparar, así que la columna de estado dice "unknown — nothing recorded" (desconocido, nada registrado) y la nota explica por qué.

records.context: **The scan never blocks the window.** Walking a plate folder is tens of thousands of ``stat`` calls, and doing it on the main GUI execution path would freeze the application for however long the filesystem takes. Everything goes through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, whose completion handlers here are **bound methods** — read that module's docstring for what a closure connected to ``thread.finished`` costs. The background activity spinner follows the processing session registry on its own, so nothing here has to drive it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The scan never blocks the window.** Walking a plate folder is tens of thousands of ``stat`` calls, and doing it on the GUI thread would freeze the application for however long the filesystem takes. Everything goes through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, whose completion handlers here are **bound methods** — read that module's docstring for what a closure connected to ``thread.finished`` costs. The background activity spinner follows the run registry on its own, so nothing here has to drive it.
records.translation: **El escaneo nunca bloquea la ventana.** Recorrer una carpeta de placa supone decenas de miles de llamadas a ``stat``, y hacerlo en el hilo de la GUI congelaría la aplicación durante todo lo que tarde el sistema de archivos. Todo pasa por :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, cuyos manejadores de finalización aquí son **métodos enlazados**; lea el docstring de ese módulo para saber lo que cuesta un cierre conectado a ``thread.finished``. El indicador de actividad en segundo plano sigue por sí solo el registro de ejecuciones, así que aquí nada tiene que controlarlo.

records.context: **And neither does opening the application view, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* application view: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the main GUI execution path: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk executes on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the application view draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **And neither does opening the screen, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* screen: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the GUI thread: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk runs on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the screen draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.translation: **Tampoco lo bloquean abrir la pantalla ni abrir su selector de carpetas.** Dos cosas aquí reciben una ruta que el usuario escribió en *otra* pantalla: las carpetas de búsqueda que :func:`make_project_browser_screen` toma de la lista de orígenes recientes, y la carpeta en la que se abre el diálogo "Add folder…". Ninguna se comprueba con ``os.path.isdir`` en el hilo de la GUI: medido en una estación de trabajo, una de esas carpetas estaba bajo un montaje ``autofs`` cuyo recurso compartido estaba en reposo, y un único ``isdir`` sobre ella no había retornado al cabo de veinte segundos, congelando toda la aplicación sin ningún traceback. Ambas consultan :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, que responde desde una caché y hace los stat en segundo plano. Esas dos son todo el inventario: el recorrido se ejecuta en un hilo de trabajo, y cada columna, nota y línea de detalle que dibuja la pantalla se genera a partir del :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` congelado que ya devolvió ese recorrido, así que rellenar la tabla y el panel de detalle no lee nada.

records.context: ``_QueueRunner`` is parented to this widget and executes whole workflows, so its independent execution path can be hours long. Destroying the application view with it executing deletes a live QThread, which Qt answers with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. It also does not go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, so the process-wide run registry — and therefore ``MainWindow.closeEvent``'s drain — cannot see it.
records.translation: ``_QueueRunner`` tiene como padre este widget y ejecuta pipelines completos, así que su hilo puede durar horas. records.translation: **Volcano Explorer** es la única vía de spaCR para figuras de publicación. Su gráfico de volcán es un renderizado de matplotlib tras un estilo de 56 campos que se puede guardar y volver a cargar como JSON, con cada punto destacado etiquetado, el color o la forma determinados por un archivo de anotación fusionado mediante una clave inferida, columnas x/y arbitrarias y un renderizado vectorial a tamaño de revista. records.context: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression processing session. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the processing session loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.

records.source: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression run. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the run loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
records.translation: **Hit List** muestra una fila clasificada por gen para la ejecución de regresión cargada. Los backends que informan valores p reciben valores q de Benjamini–Hochberg calculados sobre los genes analizados; los backends penalizados clasifican en su lugar por frecuencia de selección bootstrap y no informan valores q. Cada fila incluye la estimación del efecto, un intervalo del 95% cuando hay un error estándar disponible y la concordancia de signo de los gRNA cuando hay coeficientes a nivel de guía. Los CSVs de anotación se reducen a una fila por gen antes de uniones de muchos a uno validadas. La :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` completa se instala como la pestaña **Hits** después de Guide support, sigue la ejecución cargada por el panel de resultados y exporta la lista filtrada mostrada como CSV, Markdown o HTML autónomo.

records.context: Each volcano shows one correction family. A guide permutation writes every minimum-support family stacked into one long table, and fits one family per response when several outcomes were fitted. Each of those is its own Benjamini-Hochberg family, so drawing the table unfiltered puts a guide on the plot two to four times at different heights and pools two corrections into one picture. :func:`single_correction_family` is the cut, and :func:`install_correction_families` puts it in front of the panel's own ``set_frame`` so every route into the panel -- a finished processing session, a folder opened by hand, a dropped bundle -- draws one family.

records.source: Each volcano shows one correction family. A guide permutation writes every minimum-support family stacked into one long table, and fits one family per response when several outcomes were fitted. Each of those is its own Benjamini-Hochberg family, so drawing the table unfiltered puts a guide on the plot two to four times at different heights and pools two corrections into one picture. :func:`single_correction_family` is the cut, and :func:`install_correction_families` puts it in front of the panel's own ``set_frame`` so every route into the panel -- a finished run, a folder opened by hand, a dropped bundle -- draws one family.
records.translation: Cada gráfico de volcán muestra una sola familia de corrección. Una permutación de guías escribe todas las familias de soporte mínimo apiladas en una tabla larga, y ajusta una familia por respuesta cuando se ajustaron varios resultados. Cada una de ellas es su propia familia de Benjamini-Hochberg, así que dibujar la tabla sin filtrar pone una guía en el gráfico de dos a cuatro veces a distintas alturas y mezcla dos correcciones en una imagen. :func:`single_correction_family` es el corte, y :func:`install_correction_families` lo coloca delante del ``set_frame`` propio del panel para que todas las vías de entrada al panel (una ejecución terminada, una carpeta abierta a mano, un paquete soltado) dibujen una sola familia.

Two things follow, and both mislead on a plot: the same guide is drawn two to four times at different heights, and two Benjamini-Hochberg corrections share one axis -- so a q-value read off the picture belongs to whichever family the point came from, which nothing on the picture says.
records.translation: Una permutación de guías ajusta las mismas guías una vez por umbral de soporte mínimo y una vez por respuesta, apila todo en una tabla larga y corrige cada pila por separado. De ello se derivan dos cosas, y ambas inducen a error en un gráfico: la misma guía se dibuja de dos a cuatro veces a distintas alturas, y dos correcciones de Benjamini-Hochberg comparten un eje, de modo que un valor q leído en la imagen pertenece a la familia de la que procede el punto, algo que nada en la imagen indica.

records.context: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_cellpose#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.
records.translation: Cuando cambia la pestaña activa, las opciones nombradas por el mapa de propagación de ``cellpose_masks`` en :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` se copian a la pestaña de destino cuando esa pestaña expone la opción correspondiente. ``src`` y ``model_name`` no se copian. Al entrar en Apply, el banco de trabajo busca en ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` puntos de control cuyo nombre empiece por el ``model_name`` de la pestaña Train. Prefiere los puntos de control completos a los periódicos ``_epoch_`` y selecciona el candidato modificado más recientemente del grupo preferido. Si lo encuentra, esa ruta se asigna a ``custom_model``, que :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resuelve antes que ``model_name``; en caso contrario, Apply conserva su selección de modelo actual.

records.context: **Discovery runs off the main GUI execution path.** A scan walks a model tree and parses every progress CSV under it, which on a real screen is hundreds of files. It goes through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` like every other spaCR job; tests pass ``threaded=False``, which runs the same code inline. records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Discovery runs off the GUI thread.** A scan walks a model tree and parses every progress CSV under it, which on a real screen is hundreds of files. It goes through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` like every other spaCR job; tests pass ``threaded=False``, which runs the same code inline. Drawing stays on the GUI thread — by then the data is already in memory.
records.translation: **El descubrimiento se ejecuta fuera del hilo de la GUI.** Un escaneo recorre un árbol de modelos y analiza cada CSV de progreso que contiene, lo que en un cribado real son cientos de archivos. Pasa por :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, como cualquier otro trabajo de spaCR; las pruebas pasan ``threaded=False``, que ejecuta el mismo código en línea. El dibujo se queda en el hilo de la GUI: para entonces los datos ya están en memoria.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no runs, a run with no curves, a metric nothing logged — all of it lands in the inline status and problem labels. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.
records.translation: **Ningún diálogo modal en ninguna ruta de error.** Una carpeta sin ejecuciones, una ejecución sin curvas, una métrica que nada registró: todo ello aparece en las etiquetas integradas de estado y de problemas. Un QMessageBox bloquea una ejecución sin interfaz gráfica.

records.translation: **Las ejecuciones defectuosas se enumeran, no se ocultan.** Una carpeta que contiene puntos de control pero ningún ``train.csv`` sigue apareciendo, marcada, con su nota en la línea de problemas.

records.context: **The diff is bucketed, never flat.** It renders :func:`spacr.train_compare.diff_settings`, which reuses the provenance bucketing from :mod:`spacr.run_journal`: environment drift (paths, hosts, worker counts) is shown in its own bucket instead of being counted as something the user changed, and schema drift is summarised. When two processing sessions match, the table says "no differences" in words rather than going blank.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The diff is bucketed, never flat.** It renders :func:`spacr.train_compare.diff_settings`, which reuses the provenance bucketing from :mod:`spacr.run_journal`: environment drift (paths, hosts, worker counts) is shown in its own bucket instead of being counted as something the user changed, and schema drift is summarised. When two runs match, the table says "no differences" in words rather than going blank.
records.translation: **Las diferencias se agrupan, nunca se presentan en plano.** Se representa :func:`spacr.train_compare.diff_settings`, que reutiliza la agrupación de procedencia de :mod:`spacr.run_journal`: la deriva del entorno (rutas, hosts, número de trabajadores) se muestra en su propio grupo en lugar de contarse como algo que cambió el usuario, y la deriva del esquema se resume. Cuando dos ejecuciones coinciden, la tabla dice "no differences" (sin diferencias) con palabras en lugar de quedarse en blanco.

records.source: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` sets ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` and a white palette, and the figure carries a solid ``facecolor``. Three opaque things stacked: the area right of "Runs found" was a flat dark rectangle whatever the page-opacity slider said, with square corners where every other container on the page has rounded ones.
records.translation: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` establece ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` y una paleta blanca, y la figura lleva un ``facecolor`` sólido. Tres elementos opacos apilados: la zona a la derecha de "Runs found" era un rectángulo oscuro plano dijera lo que dijera el control deslizante de opacidad de la página, con esquinas rectas donde todos los demás contenedores de la página las tienen redondeadas.

records.context: QSS cannot fix that — a ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` widget never lets the sheet's background through, and a stylesheet cannot round a canvas matplotlib draws edge to edge. So the panel is drawn in ``paintEvent``, underneath the figure, and the figure's own patch is made fully transparent so the panel is what shows.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare.panel_canvas_class#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: QSS cannot fix that — a ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` widget never lets the sheet's background through, and a stylesheet cannot round a canvas matplotlib draws edge to edge. So the panel is drawn in ``paintEvent``, underneath the figure, and the figure's own patch is made fully transparent so the panel is what shows.
records.translation: La QSS no puede arreglarlo: un widget con ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` nunca deja pasar el fondo de la hoja de estilos, y una hoja de estilos no puede redondear un lienzo que matplotlib dibuja de borde a borde. Por eso el panel se dibuja en ``paintEvent``, debajo de la figura, y el parche propio de la figura se hace completamente transparente para que lo que se vea sea el panel.

records.translation: Esta pantalla abre una carpeta de resultados (o un único CSV de resultados) y la entrega a :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer.VolcanoExplorer`, que dibuja el gráfico con el mismo renderizador que usó el pipeline, de modo que el gráfico en pantalla es el gráfico del pipeline y no una aproximación.
